ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Health Insurance Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent health insurance fraud case in Minnesota and explore the larger issue of health insurance fraud in the state.
questions: What is the extent of health insurance fraud in Minnesota?
How are state and federal agencies working to combat this type of fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover a larger scheme and hold those responsible accountable.
